caseName: de Galard de Brassac de Bearn v. Winans
caseNameFull: Louis Elie Joseph Henry de Galard de Brassac de Bearn, Count and Prince of Bearn and Chalais, in Error v. Ross R. Winans and Ferdinand C. Latrobe, Trustees
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Maryland.
attorneys: Mr. Maurice Leon for the plaintiff in error. Mr. J. Kemp Bartlett, Mr. Edgar Allan Poe, Mr. Shirley Carter, Mr. Albert C. Ritchie and Mr. Edward Duffy for the defendants in error.

opinions.text: Per Curiam. Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. First National Bank v. Estherville, 215 U. S. 341, 346; Rogers v. Clark Iron Co., 217 U. S. 589 — see Louis Elie Joseph Henry de Galard de Brassac de Bearn v. Francois de Bearn, 225 U. S. 695; same v. Pierre de Bearn, decided at this term, 231 U. S. 742.
